## greenhelix-agent-contract-lifecycle v1.2.0

- Updated the SKILL.md documentation for clearer structure and improved guidance.
- No changes to code functionality; this release is documentation-only.

Version 1.1.0 of greenhelix-agent-contract-lifecycle

- Added a notice clarifying this guide is educational, contains illustrative (non-executable) code, and requires implementation in your own environment.
- Updated description to specify detailed Python code examples instead of production-ready code.
- Added new metadata fields: `executable: false`, `credentials: none`, `install: none`.
- No changes to core chapters or contract lifecycle content.

Initial release of greenhelix-agent-contract-lifecycle.

- Provides a comprehensive guide for automated agent contract lifecycle management, including machine-readable SLAs, escrow-backed execution, real-time SLA tracking, automated enforcement, and renewal workflows.
- Includes production-ready Python code for every contract management pattern.
- Utilizes GreenHelix A2A Commerce Gateway API for all contract workflows, ensuring end-to-end automation without human intervention.
- Covers key lifecycle stages: agreement formation, escrow binding, obligation tracking, penalty enforcement, contract amendments, renewals, and termination.
- Designed for compatibility with openclaw.
